title: Tenant action matrix and evidence attach - incident 2026-09-09
content:
Purpose
Short, customer-facing briefing plus an action matrix so tenants can pick the remediation path that suits them. Also: a detachable evidence checklist we will include when offering replays or credits. This is a working draft intended for review by SRE and Legal before publishing.

Public status page snippet (60–140 chars)
We experienced intermittent inference response delays and occasional truncated structured outputs on 2026-09-09. Recovery is complete; we are offering verification and optional replay for impacted requests. Full customer details below.

One-line TL;DR for customers
What happened: transient cache inconsistency + autoscaler thrash led to increased queuing and some truncated streaming responses. Who's impacted: a subset of requests processed in US-west region between 09:12–09:46 UTC. What we offer: evidence package + optional replay or credit depending on customer preference.

Customer action matrix (pick one)
Option A — "Verify only" (low effort, recommended for most customers)
- Timeline: immediate
- Action for customer: run the attached verification checklist (small curl script + sample request ids). No changes to integration required.
- Outcome: We provide a signed evidence bundle (request ids, timestamps, truncated payload samples) and confirm integrity. No replay performed.

Option B — "Replay only" (medium effort)
- Timeline: within 72 hours; replay run asynchronously by us
- Action for customer: opt-in via support form (link below) and provide tenant id + earliest affected request id sample.
- Outcome: We reprocess impacted requests through the same model version used at incident time and supply replayed outputs plus a comparison report highlighting differences. Data retention and privacy: replays run in tenant-isolated capacity; we will not retain replay outputs beyond the report unless explicitly requested.

Option C — "Replay + Rollforward" (higher effort, for customers who need immediate consistency)
- Timeline: schedule within 5 business days
- Action for customer: request scheduled replay with optional re-ingest. If re-ingest is requested, customer supplies S3/hosted payloads (or we pull via secure link). Requires a short technical call.
- Outcome: We run replay, optionally re-ingest, and provide a rollback/rollforward plan (if application state must be reconciled).

Evidence attachment checklist (what we will send to customer)
- Signed manifest (HMAC) containing request ids and UTC timestamps (string list)
- Sampled raw responses (up to 10 per tenant by default) showing truncation or anomalies
- Inference engine logs for the sample requests (metadata only: start/end time, routing decision, model variant)
- Autoscaler & instance metrics (CPU/GPU utilization, queue length) for the window
- Brief root-cause summary (operator-friendly language) and the replay comparison report when available

How customers verify evidence locally (quick guide)
1) Receive ZIP with manifest.json (HMAC provided separately).
2) Run our verification script: ./verify-evidence.sh --manifest manifest.json --hmac <value>
3) Script validates request ids, timestamps, and checks signatures. It also optionally replays a single request through the customer’s test endpoint to validate behavior.

Recommended status page timeline (internal use)
- 09:12 UTC: first alerts — elevated tail latency in US-west
- 09:15–09:30: ops attempted autoscaler param tweak (no effect)
- 09:30: identified cache invalidation race causing stale prefix cache hits + queue accumulation
- 09:46: mitigation: temporary conservative autoscaler settings + cache invalidation fix deployed
- 10:05: metrics improving; monitoring watch until 12:00 UTC

Short technical summary for customers (non-technical language)
A race condition between our prefix cache invalidation logic and autoscaler decisions occasionally caused request handlers to use partially-stale KV cache entries, which increased per-request processing time and in a small number of streaming sessions caused structured outputs to truncate prematurely. We patched the cache invalidation ordering and adjusted autoscaler thresholds to prevent recurrence.

Suggested customer FAQ snippets (for Customer Success to copy into replies)
Q: Were my data or prompts exposed?
A: No. This incident affected runtime behavior and did not result in any data exfiltration. All processing occurred within tenant-isolated environments.

Q: How do I know if I was impacted?
A: Provide us the tenant id and one example request id (or we can provide a sampled list). We will run a verification and report back with details.

Q: Will you replay production traffic automatically?
A: No — we will only replay on customer request. Customers select an option in the action matrix above.

Draft customer-facing email (short)
Subject: Brief incident notice and options to verify or replay impacted requests
Hi <CustomerName>,
On 2026-09-09 we observed intermittent inference delays and some truncated outputs affecting requests routed through the US-west region between 09:12–09:46 UTC. We’ve deployed a fix and monitoring shows the service is healthy.
We can: (1) send a verification evidence bundle, (2) run replays of affected requests, or (3) schedule a full replay + re-ingest. Please reply with which option you prefer and include a sample request id if available.
Apologies for the interruption — we’re prioritizing integrity checks for affected customers.
Thanks,
Aisha, Customer Success

Operator notes / internal checklist (to hand to SRE before sending to customer)
- Confirm HMAC signing key rotated for this bundle and that Legal has approved the evidence manifest template.
- Verify that any logs included have been scrubbed of PII beyond request ids and timing metadata.
- Confirm replay environment uses the same model revision and quantization profile as production at incident time.
- Confirm rate limits on replays to avoid impacting current production capacity.

Open questions / items to resolve (notes to self)
- Decide default sample size per tenant for evidence (10 is suggested; confirm with legal).
- Draft short statuspage update variations for enterprise customers vs public page.
- Confirm SRE owner for replay runs and SLA for delivering comparison report (target 72 hours).

Attachments to produce with final communication
- verify-evidence.sh (script)
- manifest template (manifest.json.example)
- short replay opt-in form (CS portal link)
- canned statuspage snippets (short + long)

Revision history
- 2026-09-09 created by Aisha Kapoor (initial draft)
- 2026-09-11 updated with SRE timeline and added operator checklist (Diego Martinez)

-- end --
